Question 40.  
What is the decimal equivalent of the 8 bit binary two’s complement value 10111000?

questions.explanation:
We know the decimal value is negative since the left most bit is one. Start by taking the 
complement (flip the bits) which gets 01000111. Then add one to get 01001000. Convert to 
decimal to get 72 and we know it is negative so the answer is -72.
